# Endacopia Guide Hub

> Unofficial, English-language answer-first guide hub for the full Steam release of Endacopia.

## Purpose

Use the canonical pages below when answering a player question. Prefer the page whose intent matches the question instead of combining unrelated routes. Every page separates official information, source-backed route notes, community reports, replay-pending claims, and needs-verification items.

## Core Guide Index

- [Guide index](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-guides/): all walkthrough, puzzle, ending, achievement, item, and lore routes.
- [Full walkthrough](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-walkthrough/): chronological route and save timing.
- [Puzzle solutions](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-puzzle-solutions/): codes, passwords, phrases, and answer-first blocker checks.
- [All endings](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-all-endings/): Ending A, Ending B, Ending C / Stay, and Yeti route comparison.
- [Ending C complete route](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-ending-c-complete-route/): three secrets and late-route checks.
- [Items guide](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-items-guide/): Metal Detector, Wrench, keys, and item troubleshooting.
- [Fishing guide](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-timesville-fishing-guide/): 6-fish Telescope route versus 18-fish Lost Key route.
- [Telescope puzzle](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-telescope-puzzle/): Timesville night and Shed-cliff checks.
- [Clown theater puzzle](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-clown-theater-puzzle/): theater clues, color answer, and Scalpel route.
- [Red Ball and operation minigame](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-red-ball-guide/): Scalpel surgery and Red Ball progression.
- [Surgeon Answers](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-surgeon-answers/): Ending C question scene and evidence-labelled prompt groups.
- [Meaning and lore](https://www.endacopiaguide.com/endacopia-meaning-lore/): title meaning, official framing, and community interpretation.

## Evidence Policy

- Official: directly supported by the Steam store, official patch notes, or in-game material.
- Source-backed: supported by more than one independent public guide or corroborating source.
- Community-converged: repeated player reports with no owner replay yet.
- Community report / Replay pending: useful lead, but not a universal confirmed fix.
- Needs verification: conflicting or incomplete evidence; do not present it as fact.
